reason: Verify every affected active backend contract was considered and updated only to implemented behavior.
Audit reconnect, retry, cancellation, resource bounds and recovery against concrete consumers and deterministic tests.
Trace target, principal generation, operation bytes, attachment identity, revision and errors end to end.
Detect duplicate Session registries, codecs, replay windows, connection owners, terminal parsers or secret readers.
Check cfg completeness, macOS no-network enforcement, Linux runtime evidence and Windows shared compile cleanliness.
Check new modules respect crate ownership and do not leak transport or platform details across layers.
Verify kind uniqueness, compatibility, validation, bounds, canonical identifiers and redacted Debug surfaces.
Verify same-UID admission, strict unary EOF, bounded duplex leftovers, autospawn policy and no secret or Endpoint leakage to CLI.
Verify local and remote adapters share one SessionService and preserve controller, replay, resource and shutdown invariants.
Verify normal versus pair ALPN separation, ConnectionDemand lifetime, generation rechecks, revoke fairness and stream isolation.
Verify directional device lookup and identity reset use exact managed state with safe lifecycle locking and no RevokeSelf.
Confirm connection loss, revoke, detach, CLI cancellation and adapter Drop cannot terminate or signal a PTY.
Confirm remote backpressure and reconnect do not block PTY drain, revision publication, resize or finalization.
Verify snapshot and delta continuity, bounded projection, controlled ANSI and authoritative resynchronization.
Check stable domain error projection, peer-generic authorization failures and actionable local CLI diagnostics.
Scan logging, Debug, JSON, errors and fixtures for ticket, terminal, cwd, key, route and direct-address leakage.
Check focused and full gates, deterministic race evidence, hosted platform coverage and task validation.
Compare the final implementation with the pre-task owners, seams, constraints and known risks.
Check the M4 local behavior and Session ownership handoff did not regress during shared-server extraction.
Check the M5-M6 broker and authorization handoff was integrated without widening Endpoint or route ownership.
Verify multiple Session streams reuse one primary connection without cross-stream head-of-line blocking.
Verify local and remote clients reach the same SessionId and only explicit takeover changes controller.
Check persistence remains process-agnostic and no agent, tmux or program-name special case entered production.
Check reconnect never replays unsynchronized input and always falls back to an authoritative snapshot on gaps.
Verify revoke cuts current and future remote effects only after durable ordering while host Sessions remain live.
Check public wording and implementation do not overclaim per-session or low-trust isolation.
Verify the public CLI matches the confirmed one-view shape and does not pull future tab or mobile scope forward.
